ControlObjectives.name: Assess Cloud Security Risks
ControlObjectives.description: Perform risk assessments, threat modeling, and attack surface assessments to identify application threats and accurately scope security resources.

ControlObjectives.name: Secure Object Storage
ControlObjectives.description: Ensure data in cloud object storage is properly protected against unauthorized public access using access management policies or cryptographic controls.

ControlObjectives.name: Enforce Network Segmentation
ControlObjectives.description: Utilize Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) and subnets to isolate application components and protect sensitive systems from direct internet exposure.

ControlObjectives.name: Define Trust Boundaries
ControlObjectives.description: Establish explicit trust configurations and boundaries between internal components and external entities, verifying claims based on quantitative risk factors.

ControlObjectives.name: Monitor and Log Cloud Environment
ControlObjectives.description: Maintain comprehensive visibility into the cloud environment by logging requests and monitoring system performance to detect anomalies and track threats.

ControlObjectives.name: Protect Against Web Threats
ControlObjectives.description: Deploy defensive security tooling to protect internet-facing applications from malicious web payloads, automated abuse, and denial-of-service attacks.

ControlObjectives.name: Adhere to Shared Responsibility Model
ControlObjectives.description: Identify and securely manage the components of the cloud technology stack that fall under the developer's responsibility across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS environments.

ControlPatterns.name: IAM-based Storage Access
ControlPatterns.description: Use persistent control plane IAM credentials attached to backend compute resources to interact with object storage on the user's behalf, preventing direct end-user access to the storage system.

ControlPatterns.name: Cryptographically Signed URLs
ControlPatterns.description: Generate dynamic, cryptographically signed URLs to grant entities temporary, direct access to specific, non-sensitive resources in object storage without exposing the entire bucket.

ControlPatterns.name: Public and Private Subnet Routing
ControlPatterns.description: Place internet-facing entry points (load balancers, API gateways) in public subnets, while strictly isolating sensitive backend systems (databases, backend servers) inside private subnets.

ControlPatterns.name: Strict Trust Boundaries (Zero Trust)
ControlPatterns.description: Configure systems such that no component trusts another. Require explicit authentication, authorization checks, and ephemeral identity assumption for all data passing between internal components.

ControlPatterns.name: Risk-Based Trust Boundaries
ControlPatterns.description: Verify authentication at the API gateway and explicitly delegate trust to downstream compute instances for lower-risk operations to optimize performance while maintaining security.

ControlPatterns.name: Web Application Firewall (WAF) Integration
ControlPatterns.description: Attach a WAF to public entry points using cloud-managed and custom rule sets to block common attack payloads (e.g., XSS, SQLi), filter acceptable routes, and rate-limit sensitive APIs.

ControlPatterns.name: Comprehensive Layer 7 Logging
ControlPatterns.description: Log all layer 7 HTTP calls with headers and caller metadata, mask sensitive PII, and propagate trace IDs through the request lifecycle to track errors and malicious actions.

ControlPatterns.name: Infrastructure Anomaly Monitoring
ControlPatterns.description: Establish environment-specific baselines and configure alerts for anomalous activity, including HTTP 4xx/5xx spikes, abnormal resource consumption, and deployment errors.

ControlPatterns.name: DDoS Protection Integration
ControlPatterns.description: Enable cloud-provider managed DDoS protection services (e.g., AWS Shield, GCP Cloud Armor) and WAF rate limiting to protect internet-facing applications against volume-based attacks.

ControlPatterns.name: Automated Infrastructure Updates
ControlPatterns.description: Implement automated mechanisms to regularly update minor versions, patch operating systems, and refresh compute images for self-managed cloud services (IaaS/PaaS).
